verdict.rationale: Neon is a database platform, not an agentic client application — the story asks whether Neon can consume external MCP servers' tools, which is a category mismatch. Evidence instead shows Neon ships an official MCP *server* (neon-docs-12/33, neon-probe-4) for other agents to use, i.e. the reverse role, so this client-side axis does not apply.
